run_decode_clothing_features: run the script to decode clothing features from a saved pickle dictionary and generate images
run_model_inference_given_feature: run model inference using label tensors and texture features to generate clothing images
create_model_from_test_options: create a model from TestOptions parsed via argparse for clothing generation tasks
load_texture_codes_dict: load a saved texture codes pickle dictionary mapping filenames to clothing features
save_generated_clothing_images: save generated clothing images in Lab color mode with optional background removal
